why: Advice 1 correctly explains the churn math behind the 'discount' (its break-even figures of about 3.3% churn and $490 are right) and gives a sensible way to test the plan, though it underplays that customers who ask for annual billing tend to be the most loyal. Advice 2 has sharper next steps and success measures, but its '11-months-for-the-price-of-12' suggestion makes no sense and its 20-of-40 success threshold is arbitrary.
